payload.subject: Mathematics
payload.lesson_type_evidence: We can subtract 47 from 72, but we need to borrow some rupees from our neighbour, who has 10 rupees.

concept_map.concept: Subtracting zero and subtracting the same number

learning_objectives: Students will be able to subtract two-digit numbers using borrowing.
Students will understand the concept of borrowing from a neighboring place value.
learning_outcomes: Students can solve subtraction problems that require borrowing accurately.
Students can explain why borrowing is needed and how it works.
misconceptions: Students may think borrowing changes the value of the number incorrectly.
Students may forget to reduce the borrowed place by one.
suggested_instructional_sequence: Introduce the concept of place value using concrete objects.
Demonstrate borrowing with a story of neighbours.
Guided practice with two-digit subtraction problems.
